_comment: The auth-boundary string contract (identity slice E-7, design P3). These strings appear VERBATIM in the SQL that raises them (migrations 0027 and 0033 — the latest defining migration per family; authContract.test.ts greps them, and verify-0027 §C / verify-0033 §A pin them against live pg_proc.prosrc so a future CREATE OR REPLACE can't drift silently). The client matcher imports THIS file; never retype a string on either side. The verify runner injects these via psql -v.

joinClassErrors.notStudent: Only student accounts can join a class
joinClassErrors.badCode: No class found for that code
joinClassErrors.domainTemplate: This class is limited to % accounts

redeemErrors.signedOut: Sign in before joining a class
redeemErrors.wrongRole: Teacher accounts cannot join a class as a student
redeemErrors.classFull: This class is full. Ask your teacher for help.

claimTeacherErrors.signedOut: Sign in before setting up a teacher account
claimTeacherErrors.alreadySetUp: This account is already set up
claimTeacherErrors.classCapTemplate: This account is limited to 5 classes

gradeErrors.blockNotInSection: That question is not in this section
gradeErrors.notGradable: Only written-answer questions can be graded
gradeErrors.criterionNotOnRubric: That criterion is not on this rubric
gradeErrors.pointsOutOfRange: Points must be between 0 and the maximum

signupRefusalTemplate: Email % is not permitted to sign up
_transportNote: signupRefusalTemplate is RETIRED as a live behavior by 0033 — the trigger's else-branch now admits a contained 'pending' role instead of raising, so no unknown-email refusal reaches signup at all. The string stays in this file because verify-0027 §C asserts its ABSENCE from the deployed trigger body (a re-added refusal would silently regress self-serve admission). joinClassErrors, redeemErrors and claimTeacherErrors DO reach the client verbatim via PostgREST rpc error messages — that transport difference is why 0033 moved every refusal into an RPC.
_announceNote: announcements are what the aria-live region says; the a11y lane asserts these strings, so they live here rather than inline in the component (R5-DR).
